title: Early Return with Question Mark
goal: Replace explicit error checking with the try operator.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: Look at the function return type. It returns a Result.
Use the try operator to return early if string parsing fails.
explanation: The `?` operator unwraps `Ok` values or returns early on `Err`. Using `.unwrap()` panics on invalid input instead of returning a `Result::Err`. Omitting `?` leaves the value as a `Result`, causing type mismatch error `E0308` when performing addition.
